items.headline: 81歲哈里森獲布克獎

sources.summary: Tate Britain, London Trying to present these two as pioneers of British art is fruitless: their lives, sexualities and the Picasso and Cézanne paintings in their home were more exciting than what’s here The Bloomsbury Group once induced yawns as the smug epitome of a snobbish high culture but they’re now admired for their feminism and queer abandon. There’s a West End play about the loves of the Bloomsbury economist John Maynard Keynes and if you visit the National Trust’s Sissinghurst , its flowerbeds are set alight by Vita Sackville-West’s affair with Virginia Woolf. But biography can’t set art alight, as Tate Britain’s epic yet flaccid roam through the complicated lives and desperately mediocre paintings of the co-habiting Vanessa Bell and Duncan Grant proves. While Keynes was quite the economist and Woolf a literary genius, I honestly can’t see enough interest in the visual art of Bloomsbury to detain anyone for long. That was true when their sex lives were spoken of in a more muted way (I read a biography of Keynes as a student and don’t remember any hanky-panky at all) and it’s true now, even as we trawl their paintings for gay and feminist meanings. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: He thinks painting is futile, the YBAs were an embarrassment, and most artists today might as well be working in carpet shops. So why is his new show full of, er, paintings? We meet the confounding British artist ‘This is so bad isn’t it?” says Ryan Gander, grinning like a naughty schoolboy. “People are going to hate me when you write this up.” The 50-year-old conceptual artist has just finished telling me why, not only does he dislike drawing or painting, he finds the very act “futile and dumb”. He explains: “Copying reality with a pencil and paper just seems completely mad to me. It’s such a weird act. Why would I draw you when I could just take a photograph?” Gander has many such opinions, from how we measure the value of work to why 90s Brit art was a load of nonsense (more on that later). He also has a superb way of communicating that makes whatever he says seem like the most obvious thing in the world. After an entertaining couple of hours in his company, I leave thinking: “It’s not Gander who’s mad – it’s everyone else.” Continue reading...

美國華府智庫「戰爭研究所」跟「美國企業研究所」發布報告，示警中國可能在進行大規模、沒有事先預告的「無聲」軍演，目的是孤立台灣、削弱台灣自我防衛的信心。國防部長顧立雄證實，中國人民解放軍近期確實在西太平洋進行演練。

🇹🇼 台灣相關 ——

美國華府智庫「戰爭研究所」跟「美國企業研究所」發布報告，示警中國可能在進行大規模、沒有事先預告的「無聲」軍演，目的是孤立台灣、削弱台灣自我防衛的信心。

國防部長顧立雄證實，中國人民解放軍近期確實在西太平洋進行演練。

voice.text: 這則跟台灣有關。美國智庫示警，中國可能在進行「無聲」軍演。發出警告的是華府的戰爭研究所跟美國企業研究所。他們說，軍演的目的是孤立台灣，削弱台灣自我防衛的信心。國防部長顧立雄證實，中國人民解放軍近期確實在西太平洋演練。

sources.name: 公視
sources.summary: 美國華府智庫戰爭研究所與美國企業研究所日前發布針對兩岸情勢的報告中，示警中共恐正在進行大規模、沒有預告的「無聲」軍演，目的是孤立台灣並削弱我方自我防衛的信心；國防部長顧立雄證實，共軍近期的確在西太平洋進行演練。
